high_level_description: The image features a person dressed in a Minnie Mouse costume, standing outdoors at night. The individual is wearing a black strapless top with a pink bow at the center, paired with a pink skirt adorned with white polka dots. The skirt has a ruffled hem, adding a playful touch to the outfit. The person also wears large, round hoop earrings and a choker necklace. The background shows a dark street scene with some blurred lights and a vehicle partially visible on the right side of the image.
